# GEOX — Earth Intelligence Sovereign Kernel (31 Public Tools)
> Doctrine: Physics before narrative. Governed evidence only.
> Surface: generated from src/geox_mcp/tools_manifest.yaml

## 1. Canonical Tool Surface

1. **geox_well_ingest**: Load well log data from LAS, SEG-Y, DST, deviation, or tops files. Auto-detects format.
2. **geox_petrophysics**: Unified petrophysics: Vsh, porosity, Sw, permeability, net pay, LEM inference, QC. Modes: generate, verify, lem_inference, stoip_feed, qc.
3. **geox_seismic_ingest**: SEG-Y I/O, header inspection, export.
4. **geox_seismic_compute**: Seismic computation: forward model, well tie, attributes, wavelet extraction, inversion.
5. **geox_seismic_interpret**: Unified seismic interpretation: horizon/fault picking, RSI pipeline, vision, contrast detection. Modes: horizon_contrast, fault_sticks, volume_frame, blend, rsi_pipeline, contrast, vision.
6. **geox_subsurface_model**: Subsurface model building: joint inversion, gravity/magnetic forward, MT forward.
7. **geox_basin**: Unified basin intelligence: profile, resolve, macrostrat, backstrip, mass balance, thermal maturity, map context, deep time, tectonic reconstruction.
8. **geox_sequence**: Unified stratigraphy: sequence analysis, biostratigraphic parsing and falsification. Modes: correlation, biostrat_parse, biostrat_falsify.
9. **geox_geomechanics**: Geomechanical analysis: bulk/shear/young modulus, poisson ratio, acoustic impedance, stress polygon.
10. **geox_deep_time_state**: Earth State Vector through deep time: GPTS, CO2, sea level, temperature, paleogeography.
11. **geox_claim**: Unified claim lifecycle: create, validate, challenge, seal, evidence, consequence, optionality, cascade, feedback integrity, truth challenge.
12. **geox_prospect**: Prospect evaluation: volumetrics, POS, EVOI, risk assessment. Modes: screen, evaluate.
13. **geox_gravmag_studio**: Gravity/magnetic studio: forward modeling and screening. Modes: open, screen.
14. **geox_well_desk**: Well desk: interactive view, publish rendered panel, render well panel. Modes: open, publish, render.
15. **geox_surface_status**: Federation-standard registry probe: tool discovery and health status.
16. **geox_evidence**: Unified evidence synthesis: discover, synthesize, abduct, contradict, spatial_block, ingest_literature.
17. **geox_basin_backstrip**: 1D basin backstripping: Steckler & Watts 1978 + Sclater & Christie 1980. Reconstruct tectonic and total subsidence through time.
18. **geox_sediment_mass_balance**: Source-to-sink sediment volume and mass accounting. Peters 2012 framework.
19. **geox_thermal_maturity_history**: Burial + heat flow + maturity modeling through time. EasyRo + TTI.
20. **geox_claim_graph_evaluate**: Evaluate parent claim validity when child claims fail. DAG evaluation with AND/OR/WEIGHTED dependencies.
21. **geox_falsify**: Popperian falsification engine. Modes: full (Kill Matrix K001-K007 + contradiction scan), quick (Kill Matrix only), physics_only (contradiction scan only), carbonate_igneous_rte (Arif Burgess-RTE Matrix — carbonate vs igneous discrimination using Burgess morphology, rheology, thermodynamics, and elasticity with Sabah-weighted scoring). GENESIS/015: physics must prove the claim is right. ANY KILL → rejected. Constitutional rule: absence of thermal evidence ≠ proof of carbonate.
22. **geox_contradiction_scan**: Scan claims for contradictions using13-type ontology. Classifies severity (FATAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW) and resolution path (VOID/HOLD/DEMOTE/ESCALATE). FATAL →888_HOLD.
23. **geox_lem_predict**: LEM inference — predict rock properties (porosity, Sw, lithology) from well log curves. Physics-prior mode (Archie, Gardner, Wyllie) until federated weights deploy.
24. **geox_to_wealth_bridge**: Cross-organ bridge: converts GEOX prospect economics to WEALTH score_kernel input. F2: epistemic_source preserved. F13: blocked nodes rejected.
25. **geox_map_export_package**: Map export: package map layers and annotations into portable formats.
26. **geox_visual_understand**: Extract visual patterns from seismic section images using deep learning.
27. **geox_visual_generate_hypotheses**: Generate geological hypotheses across discontinuity gaps in seismic data.
28. **geox_map_layers_list**: List available map layers and their spatial extents.
29. **geox_map_scene_plan**: Plan map scene composition: layer ordering, zoom, and annotation layout.
30. **geox_map_render_preview**: Render preview of map scene for quality review before export.
31. **geox_workspace**: GEOX Workspace — persistent geological context across all tools. Set basin/play/well once; every tool inherits. Modes: set, view, history, evidence, relations, reset.

## 2. Agent Reasoning Logic
- Evidence before interpretation.
- Governance stays server-side.
- App-enabled workspace URI: `ui://geox/workspace-v1.html` (text/html;profile=mcp-app).
